news.headline: Intermountain Health Brings Perimeter's Claire™ to the Operating Room, a Landmark in Breast Cancer Surgery Using AI
news.summary: Intermountain Health became the first U.S. health system to commercially deploy Perimeter's FDA-approved Claire OCT System, installing it at LDS Hospital and American Fork Hospital in Utah for real-time AI-assisted breast-cancer margin assessment. CEO Adrian Mendes called it a defining moment for Perimeter and for the use of AI in cancer surgery.

news.headline: Perimeter Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Conference Call for August 20th
news.summary: Perimeter announced it will report Q2 2026 financial and operating results after market close on August 20, 2026, followed by a management webcast and conference call to discuss results and provide a corporate update.

news.headline: Brookline starts Perimeter at buy; PT C$1.54
news.summary: Brookline Capital Markets initiated coverage of Perimeter with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 (about US$1.11) price target, citing the March 2026 FDA approval of Claire as the catalyst for an accelerating U.S. commercial rollout; shares closed at C$0.32 the prior day.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital names Perimeter and maintains Profound as healthcare Top Picks
news.summary: Paradigm Capital named Perimeter a new Top Pick with a speculative-buy rating and a C$0.95 price target, arguing that FDA approval of Claire sets up an accelerating commercial rollout while shares trade at a fraction of typical medtech M&A revenue multiples.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings call
catalysts.detail: Perimeter reports Q2 2026 financial and operating results after market close, with a management webcast and conference call to follow.

catalysts.label: CMS New Technology APC decision for Claire
catalysts.detail: Perimeter has filed for a Medicare New Technology Ambulatory Payment Classification (NT-APC) for Claire targeting a January 1, 2027 reimbursement effective date, with a CMS decision expected by year-end.

catalysts.label: Expansion of Claire hospital deployments
catalysts.detail: Following the first commercial Claire go-live at Intermountain Health's LDS and American Fork hospitals, additional hospital installations are expected as Perimeter scales its systemwide agreements.

catalysts.label: Potential NASDAQ uplisting
catalysts.detail: Analyst commentary points to a NASDAQ uplisting plan embedded in Perimeter's recent financing structure, which would involve delisting from the TSXV.

pulse: Perimeter is pivoting from regulatory approval to commercial execution: its Claire OCT system, the first FDA-approved AI-enabled device for real-time breast-cancer surgical margin assessment, went live at its first U.S. health system (Intermountain Health) in mid-August 2026, with Q2 2026 results due August 20. Sell-side sentiment has turned more constructive, with Paradigm Capital and Brookline Capital Markets both initiating or naming the stock a top pick in July (C$0.95 and C$1.54 targets) on the strength of the commercial rollout, even as shares still trade in the C$0.20-0.35 range on the TSXV. Key swing factors ahead are the pace of additional hospital go-lives, the pending CMS New Technology APC reimbursement decision targeted for January 2027, and speculation around a possible NASDAQ uplisting.
